title: Application of Nantucket Electric Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 193B, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quaterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of November, December, and January, 1986. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for the purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 an 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
